defs.def: a particular task or piece of work that you have to do （一项）任务；（一件）工作，活儿，事情
a responsibility or duty 责任；职责
a crime, especially stealing 犯罪行为（尤指偷窃）

ex.s: High conscientiousness is related to lower job performance, especially in simple jobs where it doesn’t pay to be a perfectionist.

defs.def: a particular kind of thing 东西；物件
an item of work which is done by a computer as a single unit （作为一个单元处理的）作业，工作

ex.s: With millions of people likely to take on DIY projects over that coming weeks, new research shows that more than half of people are planning to make the most of the long, warm summer days to get jobs done.

ex.s: One of the best things about this job is that you can observe animals in their natural environment.
ex.t: 这份工作最好的一点是你可以观察动物在它们自然环境中的样子。

ex.s: Job requirements Being a wildlife photographer requires good photography skills, knowledge of animal behaviour and a lot of patience.
ex.t: 工作要求：成为一名野生动物摄影师需要良好的摄影技术、对动物行为的了解以及极大的耐心。
